programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way. (Drama) - 1955

programme.title: Incident in an Alley
programme.desc: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy. (Crime drama) - 1962

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate. (Action) - 1975

programme.title: The Nun and the Sergeant
programme.desc: A Marine (Robert Webber) leads misfits on a mission in Korea with a nun (Anna Sten) and Asian schoolgirls for company. (War) - 1962

programme.title: Dangerous Exile
programme.desc: In post-revolution France, a hot-air balloon lands in Wales with a young boy in tow. Soon the locals discover the mysterious visitor is none other than Louis XVII (Richard O'Sullivan), son of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette. An American named Virginia Traill (Belinda Lee) attempts to shelter him, but word has been sent to the French revolutionaries and young Louis' life is in danger. His only hope is Philippe de Beauvais (Louis Jourdan), a loyalist who wants to restore Louis to the throne. (Adventure) - 1958

programme.title: You Have to Run Fast
programme.desc: Gangland killers catch up to a doctor (Craig Hill) hiding as a store clerk in a country town. (Crime drama) - 1961

programme.title: The Big Boodle
programme.desc: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates. (Crime drama) - 1957

programme.title: The Big Night
programme.desc: A 17-year-old (John Barrymore Jr.) grabs a pistol and goes looking for the sportswriter who caned his father (Preston Foster). (Drama) - 1951

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

programme.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
programme.desc: When popular singer Dino (Dean Martin) stops for gas in a small town near Las Vegas, mechanic Barney (Cliff Osmond) disables his car. Barney, who writes songs with local teacher Orville (Ray Walston), wants Dino to sing some of their compositions. Orville invites Dino over, but sends his wife, Zelda (Felicia Farr), away so Dino can't hit on her. He then hires prostitute Polly (Kim Novak) to play his wife. Meanwhile, Zelda goes to a bar, where she gets drunk and eventually meets a lonely Dino. (Romantic comedy) - 1964

programme.title: The Children's Hour
programme.desc: Longtime friends Martha (Shirley MacLaine) and Karen (Audrey Hepburn) run a boarding school for girls. When an unruly child, Mary (Karen Balkin), is punished for lying, she concocts a story that Karen and Martha are having a lesbian relationship. When the story spreads, parents withdraw their children from the school. The women's lawsuit for libel hits many snags when they lack witnesses to speak for them. All the stress adversely affects Karen's engagement to Joe Cardin (James Garner). (Drama, LGBTQ) - 1961

programme.title: The Night They Raided Minsky's
programme.desc: To distance herself from her strict Amish family, naïve Rachel Schpitendavel escapes to New York City to become a dancer. While Rachel's dances based on Biblical stories are too innocent for Minsky's Burlesque House, club-owner Billy Minsky plans on using Rachel's routine to humiliate critics of his business. But trouble arises when partners in a comedy duo compete for Rachel's affections. (Musical comedy) - 1968

programme.title: Hot Cars
programme.desc: A car salesman is framed for the murder of a police officer when he refuses to sell stolen vehicles for gangsters. (Crime drama) - 1956

programme.title: The Noose Hangs High
programme.desc: Two window washers (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) are mistaken for crooks by gangsters who are missing money. (Comedy) - 1948

programme.title: Her Best Move
programme.desc: Encouraged by her best friend (Lalaine), a 15-year-old soccer prodigy (Leah Pipes) learns to live like a normal teenager. (Comedy) - 2007

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets. (Musical comedy) - 1954

As he works with the ruler's men to discover who is behind the kidnapping, Rassendyll slowly falls in love with the king's fiancée, Princess Flavia (Alice Terry). (Romance) - 1922

programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2011-05-03
